purpose: Diagnose whether local matched training depresses ATCNet and EEGConformer accuracy on OpenBMI.
selection_basis: Mean accuracy across retained pre-sentinel local models; fixed without inspecting sentinel outputs.
primary_diagnostic: author-recipe sentinel accuracy minus existing matched-protocol accuracy on the same subject-seed units

interpretation_thresholds.material: absolute mean recovery >= 2 and < 5 percentage points

boundary: Training recipe is moved closer to author code while preserving the existing OpenBMI architecture ports, temporal demeaning, leak-resistant source-only epoch selection, and one-time Session-2 evaluation. This is not an exact framework-level reproduction.
